home.title: Callaz — contact centre in Kolding, Denmark
home.description: Callaz runs outbound calling for B2B teams in Denmark: appointment setting, outbound sales and customer service.

solutions.title: Solutions
solutions.description: Three outbound services, one operating method: appointment setting, outbound sales and customer service, delivered by a named team on a monthly agreement.

appointmentSetting.title: Appointment setting
appointmentSetting.description: Qualified meetings booked straight into your calendar, with agreed criteria, recorded calls and a weekly report on what the market said.

outboundSales.title: Outbound sales
outboundSales.description: A trained outbound team closing on your behalf, working from your script, your pricing and your compliance rules.

customerService.title: Customer service
customerService.description: Inbound and follow-up handling, from overflow cover to a full front line, without lengthening your own payroll.

howWeWork.title: How we work
howWeWork.description: The four phases of a Callaz campaign, from brief to steady state, plus the compliance and data rules the team works under.

about.title: About Callaz
about.description: A contact centre founded in Kolding, built for outbound work in the Danish market. Registered facts, values and address.

careers.title: Careers
careers.description: Open roles at Callaz in Kolding and remote, what we offer, and how the hiring process runs.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Reach Callaz by phone, email or the enquiry form. Registered office in Kolding, Denmark.

quote.title: Get a quote

consent.title: Cookies on callaz.dk
consent.body: We use cookies that are strictly necessary for the site to work. Anything beyond that is only set if you say yes, and you can change your mind at any time.
consent.necessaryBody: Remembers only your answer to this box. It cannot be switched off, because without it we would ask you again on every page. Your language is carried in the address and needs no cookie.
consent.analyticsBody: Anonymous measurement of which pages get read, so we know what to improve. Only set with your consent.

form.name: Name
form.messagePlaceholder: Which market, which offer, and what a good result would look like.
form.consent: I agree that Callaz may store and use the information above to answer my enquiry.
form.consentNote: We use your details to reply, and for nothing else. No newsletter, no third parties.

coverage.title: One market, and we know it
coverage.lead: We call in Denmark, in Danish — a deliberate choice over spreading thin. We know the buyer types, the objections and the rules here, and do not put a market on the site we cannot staff.
coverage.note: No queue and no menu system to click through — just a number that gets answered.

cta.title: Tell us about your market. We will say if we can sell it.
cta.body: A twenty-minute call. An honest read, and a written proposal if it fits.

steps.body: A pilot period, before anything long gets signed.

thankYou.title: Your enquiry has reached us
thankYou.body: A person reads every enquiry that comes in through this form. You will hear back within one working day.
thankYou.note: In a hurry? Call instead, and you will get an answer straight away.
